description: The estimated advertising expenditure in the local currency of the ad's geographic region, corresponding to the 'LocalSpend' field. This value is of type float.
The estimated advertising expenditure in US Dollars (USD), corresponding to the 'Spend' field. This value is inferred by applying cost-per-mille (CPM) estimates to impressions and is of type float.
Estimated number of ad exposures (impressions count)
Enumerated code indicating the channel through which media was purchased (e.g., direct, DSP, ad network)
Enumerated code indicating the channel through which the ad inventory was sold or distributed (e.g., direct, SSP, exchange)
The estimated number of times a digital advertisement was served, corresponding to the 'Impressions' field. This value is modeled from sampled observations and is of type long.
Total advertising spend for the record in USD (normalized amount)
Advertising spend in original/local currency (pre-normalization; unconverted)
